rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (not fetched): Ley 81 of 2019 sets principles, rights, obligations and procedures for processing personal data by natural or legal persons, public or private; art. 47 made it effective two years after promulgation (29 March 2021); regulated by Decreto Ejecutivo 285 of 28 May 2021 published in Gaceta Oficial 29296-A.
